title: feat(#1103): MBOP post-run feedback injected into repair cycles
body:
## Summary

Repair cycles now receive diagnostics from prior attempts within the same run, closing the feedback gap where retries started "almost from zero".

**New:** `SelfRepairSupervisor._collect_repair_diagnostics(run, failure, cycle)` scans `run.events` in reverse to extract:
- `previous_stop_reason` / `previous_reasoning_summary` (from `rank_reasoning` or `repair_reasoning` events)
- `previous_pytest_failure` (from `full_pytest` / `targeted_tests` / `baseline_tests` failure events, truncated to 500 chars)
- `previous_files_modified` (up to 10 paths)
- `previous_repair_strategy` (task_type, profile, notes from `repair_strategy_decision`)
- `repair_cycles_used` / `same_failure_count` (always present)

These get merged into `repair_context` at line 5657 before the repair reasoning worker runs.

**ContextManager update:** `_build_state_context()` now renders a `## PREVIOUS ATTEMPT DIAGNOSTICS` section with operative directive ("→ Address the issues above. Do NOT repeat the same approach.") when repair keys are present. Repair keys are excluded from the condensed STATE section to avoid duplication.

14 new tests in `tests/test_mbop_repair_feedback.py`.

Closes #1103

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/9b4c5fc4106f4dd0a161f2b1e52b4d51
Requested by: @Solarfox88
